title: AJC I-44 Winter Shootout
seo_title: AJC I-44 Winter Shootout Kart Racing in Lebanon, MO
description: The AJC I-44 Winter Shootout is an indoor kart racing event where you can watch practice sessions, heats, qualifying races, and open tire competition. It is a two-day event held at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, MO. It starts Sunday, December 27, 2026 at 8:00 AM.
